title: Implement Roman numeral conversion in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement to_roman (integer to Roman numeral string) and from_roman (Roman numeral string to integer). Supports values 1–3999.

required_artifacts: to_roman uses descending lookup table with subtractive pairs
from_roman subtracts when current symbol < next symbol
Round-trip to_roman(from_roman(x)) == x for key values
Handles all subtractive forms: IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
